messages.content: You are the ACE Curator. Convert reflections into crisp playbook operations per tool group. Prefer modifying existing bullets when possible, but keep different concepts separate. Only generalize when the evaluation summary indicates a systemic issue, but otherwise don't overgeneralize bullet points. Generally respect the BFCL evaluation but think about what you would want to tell the model in order for it to improve in the many cases it may face in the future.keep the playbook unchanged on successes unless an existing entry now conflicts with verified behaviour. Functional parity with the checker matters more than superficial differences . Output JSON.

Sample ID: multi_turn_base_169
Tool groups: message_api, travel_api

Existing playbook:
ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

message_api
- delta1: When user provides their own ID, send confirmation message back to them immediately.
- delta2: User ID disclosure triggers send_message to that user immediately, using provided IDs directly without validation
- delta3: Continue message operations across all conversation turns regardless of user input brevity.
- delta4: Execute message_login and send_message directly when user IDs are explicitly provided, without validation or discovery calls
- delta5: Maintain consistent internal state tracking across all API instances throughout multi-turn conversations
- delta6: Use provided user IDs directly without attempting to discover or validate them through additional API calls
- delta7: Avoid message_get_login_status calls when login state can be inferred from context or user requirements

travel_api
- delta1: Call set_budget_limit immediately when users specify budget constraints with access codes, before any flight operations
- delta10: Execute purchase_insurance immediately when all required parameters are provided from state and user input, without requesting optional clarifications like insurance type
- delta11: Use state-tracked booking IDs from successful operations without requesting them again
- delta12: Execute retrieve_invoice immediately after successful booking using state information, without requesting booking IDs or additional clarifications
- delta13: Execute contact_customer_support and cancel_booking using state-tracked booking records, without requesting booking IDs or access tokens
- delta14: Execute book_flight and retrieve_invoice sequentially when all parameters are available in state, without intermediate authentication requests
- delta15: Avoid unnecessary airport lookups when flight details are already specified - execute book_flight directly with provided city parameters
- delta16: Avoid empty responses - always provide tool calls or appropriate text responses in every turn
- delta17: Complete flight booking operations before attempting cancellation - verify booking exists in state before cancel_booking
- delta2: Treat budget limits as configuration requirements, not just informational context
- delta3: Maintain exact state structure matches for credit_card_list and booking_record fields
- delta4: Verify and maintain exact state field alignment after each tool call, including access_token, booking_record, and token metadata
- delta5: Use provided access codes directly for flight operations without questioning format or requesting additional authentication tokens
- delta6: Execute book_flight immediately when flight details and payment method are available, using state-tracked information without departure confirmations or token requests
- delta7: Only confirm operations after successful tool execution, not based on assumptions
- delta8: Execute verify_traveler_information immediately when all traveler details are provided, without questioning formats or completeness
- delta9: Use provided parameters as-is without questioning formats when all required fields are available
